steps.why: Primary treatment is purely physical settling, so the point of the name is that the second stage uses living organisms instead of machinery.
common_mistakes: Saying chemicals do the work. Living MICROBES do it, which is why it is biological.
Leaving out flocs. They are the named structures the microbes form.
steps.memory_tip: The second stage is done by living things, not machines.

steps.why: BOD measures how much organic matter is left, so a fall in BOD is a direct measurement that the treatment worked.
common_mistakes: Expanding BOD as 'Biological Oxygen Demand'. It is BIOCHEMICAL Oxygen Demand.
Saying treatment raises the BOD. It REDUCES it.
steps.memory_tip: Less organic matter left means less oxygen would be demanded.
